create_debug_visualizer: create a DebugVisualizer from a habitat_sim.Simulator to render and inspect debug RGB observations
peek_object: use DebugVisualizer.peek to generate a debug image centered on a physics object or scene
stitch_images: stitch a list of PIL Image objects into a single grid matrix image
project_3d_point: project a 3D world point into 2D pixel coordinates using a camera sensor
highlight_object: draw a colored circle around a ManagedRigidObject or ManagedArticulatedObject using DebugLineRender
